description: Read, search, inspect, and send Zoho Mail messages from the terminal with OAuth-backed account, folder, message, and send commands.

novel_features.name: Headless client credentials
novel_features.description: Exchange client credentials for a short-lived access token without browser interaction — useful for scripted or CI environments.

novel_features.name: Device authorization flow
novel_features.description: Polls for approval after printing a verification URL and user code — lets agents authenticate on headless machines without a redirect URI.

novel_features.name: Bitwarden/rbw auth loading
novel_features.description: Reads ZOHO_CLIENT_ID, ZOHO_CLIENT_SECRET, and ZOHO_REFRESH_TOKEN from a Bitwarden item via rbw so credentials never touch the shell history.

novel_features.name: Message search
novel_features.description: Search messages with Zoho's searchKey syntax (e.g. from:, subject:, hasAttachment:true).

novel_features.name: Send email
novel_features.description: Compose and send email via Zoho Mail REST API with from, to, subject, and content flags.
